transcript.text: Good morning everyone. Let's get the daily movement-control huddle started. We've got four routine support runs tomorrow: water resupply, engineer barrier-material delivery, communications-equipment delivery, and clinic cold-chain delivery. Vehicles V-4, V-7, V-9, and V-12 are available, and the current board shows all four departing at 0800. Before I publish the final dispatch plan, I need each of you to confirm whether your run has any requirement that would change that departure time or vehicle assignment. Motor pool, logistics, signal, medical -- what do you have for me?
transcript.speaker: A1

transcript.text: Sir, I need to flag a vehicle issue before we publish the board. My brake inspection this morning confirmed V-12 is restricted to paved routes only until its follow-up test. The water-resupply route is gravel, so V-12 can't take that run. V-7 is cleared for gravel routes and can handle the water resupply. I should note this restriction is recorded in my motor-pool worksheet but has not yet been entered on the movement board, which is why it wasn't reflected in the current plan.
